 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Lazio have a huge opportunity to consolidate their joint Serie A leadership, as they keep to the same side that crushed Juventus 3-0 when hosting Alberto Gilardino's Parma.
 It kicks off at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome at 19.45 UK time (20.45 CEST).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement You can follow all the build-up and action as it happens from today's four Serie A games on the Liveblog. 
 TURIN, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Gennaro Gattuso, Manager of S.S. Lazio, celebrates after the Serie A match between Juventus and SS Lazio at Allianz Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Chris Ricco/Getty Images)
 Gennaro Gattuso and Lazio have been truly the surprise outfit of the Serie A season so far, sitting joint top of the table with Inter, still unbeaten, and fresh from a 3-0 humiliation of Juventus in Turin. 
 The usual injuries remain, so Albert Gudmundsson, Nicolò Rovella and Adam Marusic out of action, but Kenneth Taylor has shaken off a knock and Matteo Cancellieri recovers for a spot on the bench.
 TURIN, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Oliver Provstgaard of SS Lazio scores a opening goal during the Serie A match between Juventus and SS Lazio at on October 18, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Marco Rosi – SS Lazio/Getty Images)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Tijjani Noslin is again preferred to Andrea Pinamonti upfront, flanked by Gustav Isaksen and Mattia Zaccagni.
 MILAN, ITALY – OCTOBER 10: Alberto Gilardino, Manager of Parma Calcio 1913, reacts with Emanuele Valeri of Parma Calcio 1913 during the Serie A match between FC Internazionale and Parma Calcio at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 10, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)
 Parma dismissed Carlos Cuesta after a difficult start to the season and brought in Alberto Gilardino, but he lost both games 3-0 to Inter and Torino.
 Striker Nesta Elphege had surgery for appendicitis and is therefore resting at home, with Pontus Almqvist and Hans Nicolussi Caviglia long-term absentees.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement El-Bilal Touré partners David Romero upfront, leaving teenage talent Simone Lontani on the bench.
 PARMA, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 20: José David Romero of Parma Calcio 1913 celebrates after scoring his team's first goal during the Serie A match between Parma Calcio and Genoa CFC at Stadio Ennio Tardini on September 20, 2026 in Parma, Italy. (Photo by Luca Amedeo Bizzarri/Getty Images)
 Lazio vs. Parma line-ups
 Lazio: Mandas; Floriani Mussolini, Sutalo Provstgaard, Nuno Tavares; Frattesi, Belahyane, Taylor; Isaksen, Noslin, Zaccagni
 Parma: Corvi, Diego Carlos, Troilo, Drobnic; Delprato, Ordonez, Sierro, Keita, Valeri; Touré, Romero
